mapper.select:
SELECT supplier.id, supplier.supplier_code, supplier.supplier_name, supplier.contact_person, supplier.using_department, supplier.main_products, supplier.provided_product, supplier.material_code, supplier.model, supplier.applicable_product, supplier.material_category, supplier.material_grade, supplier.status, supplier.scope_id, supplier.scope_code, supplier.scope_name FROM mes_supplier supplier INNER JOIN ( SELECT MAX(candidate.id) AS id FROM mes_supplier candidate
GROUP BY candidate.tenant_id, TRIM(candidate.supplier_code), TRIM(candidate.supplier_name) ) selected_supplier ON selected_supplier.id = supplier.id WHERE supplier.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND supplier.deleted = 0 ORDER BY CASE supplier.status WHEN 'QUALIFIED' THEN 10 WHEN 'PENDING' THEN 20 WHEN 'EXITED' THEN 30 WHEN 'UNQUALIFIED' THEN 40 ELSE 50 END, supplier.supplier_name, supplier.supplier_code
SELECT candidate.id, candidate.supplier_code, candidate.supplier_name, candidate.contact_person, candidate.using_department, candidate.main_products, candidate.provided_product, candidate.material_code, candidate.model, candidate.applicable_product, candidate.material_category, candidate.material_grade, candidate.status, candidate.scope_id, candidate.scope_code, candidate.scope_name FROM mes_supplier candidate
ORDER BY CASE candidate.status WHEN 'QUALIFIED' THEN 10 WHEN 'PENDING' THEN 20 WHEN 'EXITED' THEN 30 WHEN 'UNQUALIFIED' THEN 40 ELSE 50 END, candidate.supplier_name, candidate.supplier_code, candidate.material_code
LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
